title: Finite root bases over annihilated coefficients
statement: Let X be a scheme, l prime, W an object of its pro-etale site, and n natural. Let zeta be a section of the l^(n+1) root module on W, with an isomorphism from the unit module on that slice to the root module sending every section a to a times the restriction of zeta. Let B be any commutative internal ring in abelian sheaves on the pro-etale site, whose section groups are annihilated by l^(n+1). Then, on the same slice W, the section reconstruction of the regular B-module is isomorphic to the section reconstruction of the internal free B-module on mu_(l^(n+1)).

proof_origin.note: Extract a complete proved helper into its own module so every delivered file compiles within the per-file limit.

proof.text: Use the cyclic tensor insertion and tensor-sheafification calculation from the proved finite root basis. Annihilation makes b -> b tensor 1 a bijection from each B section group to its integer tensor with Z/N. Whisker the normalized cyclic root basis with B and the locally bijective tensor comparison. The composite is the B-linear insertion of the prescribed root section. It is locally bijective and hence an isomorphism; remove the identity-scalar restriction using comapId.

mathlib_searches.query: If a coefficient group is annihilated by N, tensoring it over integers with ZMod N is isomorphic to the coefficient group
mathlib_searches.verdict: The quotient tensor identity is the algebraic input; the sheaf normalization is supplied by the existing root-basis helpers.
These cover tensors over the base ring, rather than the integer tensor with Z/N used by the actual internal module.
Reuse the proved local cyclic insertion calculation from SpRootBasisLevel.

theorem diagonalFiniteRootBasis
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (W : X.ProEt) (n : ℕ)
    (ζ : (Scheme.purTwistRootsModule X ℓ n).val.obj (op W))
    (e : (SheafOfModules.unit
        (Scheme.purTwistRing X (Scheme.purTwistFiniteRing X ℓ n))).over W ≅
      (Scheme.purTwistRootsModule X ℓ n).over W)
    (he : ∀ (V : (Over W)ᵒᵖ)
      (a : ((Scheme.purTwistRing X (Scheme.purTwistFiniteRing X ℓ n)).over W).obj.obj V),
      e.hom.val.app V a =
        a • (Scheme.purTwistRootsModule X ℓ n).val.map V.unop.hom.op ζ)
    (B : Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    [MonObj B] [IsCommMonObj B]
    (hB : ∀ (V : X.ProEtᵒᵖ) (b : B.obj.obj V), (ℓ ^ (n + 1)) • b = 0) :
    Nonempty ((spRootBasisSliceSections X B W).obj (Mod.regular B) ≅
      (spRootBasisSliceSections X B W).obj
        ((Mod.free B).obj (Scheme.proEtaleRootsOfUnitySheaf X (ℓ ^ (n + 1)))))
